instructions:
1. Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel on the floor in front of you, arms straight and back neutral.
2. Brace your core and roll the wheel forward and to the right, extending your body into a diagonal line.
3. Keep your hips slightly back and resist your torso twisting toward the floor.
4. Pull the wheel back to the start using your core and lats.
5. Repeat to the right side, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Roll out only as far as you can keep your lower back from sagging.
2. Resist rotation; keep the torso square as the wheel tracks to the side.
3. Drive the return with your abs and lats, not your arms.
4. Inhale as you roll out, exhale as you roll back in.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent at 90 degrees and feet off the floor in a tabletop position.
2. Hold the ab wheel overhead with both hands and arms straight.
3. Crunch up and bring the wheel toward your shins, then place it gently on your shins.
4. Lower your upper body back to the floor, keeping your legs in tabletop.
5. Crunch up again, grab the wheel from your shins, and lower back down.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shins parallel to the floor throughout the movement.
2. Lift with your abs, not momentum.
3. Keep your neck relaxed and chin slightly tucked.
4. Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Raise your arms toward your knees at shoulder height.
3. Brace your core and lift your upper back off the floor, reaching forward.
4. Pause briefly at the top.
5. Lower slowly to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your neck relaxed and do not pull on it with your hands.
2. Lift with your abs, not momentum.
3. Keep your lower back in contact with the floor.
4. Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Adjust the seat and resistance, then sit on the machine and set your feet on the footrests.
2. Grab the handles with your elbows pointing forward.
3. Brace your core and crunch forward, curling your chest toward your knees.
4. Hold briefly at the bottom of the crunch.
5. Return slowly to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you crunch forward, inhale as you return.
2. Move with your abs, not momentum.
3. Keep your lower back against the backrest.
4. Control the return; do not let the weight pull you back.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Cross your arms over your chest or reach forward.
3. Exhale and curl your upper back off the floor.
4. Hold the top contraction.
5. Inhale and lower slowly to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back on the floor and curl only the upper spine.
2. Keep your neck relaxed and do not pull on your head.
3. Squeeze the abs hard during the hold.
4. Move slowly and under control.
